name: Forecast your startup runway and prepare a finance pack
why: Finds the cash-out date and builds the finance pack, the first step of the round plan: should we raise now?

name: Prepare a funding pitch evidence appendix
why: Matches every claim in the pitch to a dated source, the same check the deck skill runs on every number.

name: Pitch deck 10/20/30 checker
why: A quick structural check on slide count and talk time to run alongside the deck review prompt.

name: Write a short pitch and fix it after every no
why: Tightens the one-line story and improves it after each pass, useful during practice meetings.

name: Post-money SAFE ownership checker
why: Checks what a cap-only post-money SAFE owns after conversion and a later round, step 3 of the cap table model.

name: Check a SAFE into priced financing
why: Shows the SAFE stake before a priced round, the pool top-up and pro rata cash, matching the round model.

name: SAFE financing revision assistant
why: Reruns the SAFE conversion when round terms change, useful while term sheets are negotiated.

name: Check a convertible note conversion
why: Converts a note with accrued interest at the cap or discount price, for rounds with notes outstanding.

name: Option pool top-up checker
why: Solves the pool top-up needed to hit a term sheet target and shows who it dilutes.

name: Compare preferred exit payout terms
why: Pays out non-participating and capped participating terms side by side, the sale-case step of the term sheet prompt.

name: Weighted-average antidilution checker
why: Works out a weighted-average reset so the founder can see what an anti-dilution clause does before asking the lawyer.

name: Bad news update writer
why: Writes an update that opens with the loss and the real numbers, for the months the investor update skill calls hard.
